lines.l: Things go by under my feet
Let me out, let me out, I don't know where I'm in
Let me out, I don't know where I'm in
Looking for an answer to that
Hoping that I love and believe in
Ain't no kind of way I'll see you
And I know love can't fit this way
I have to stop and think sometimes
Let the water roll a while
Let the days go by under my feet
